segmentler.metin: The Imperial Foods plant burned with workers trapped behind locked exits.
It took only a hydraulic line repaired with improvised parts.
So how could a hydraulic line repaired with improvised parts do this?
The answer is hydraulic fluid spraying near a fryer, vaporizing and igniting — and it is why North Carolina expanded workplace safety inspections.
